ride.curvature: measured separately, not a pass threshold

opportunity: General every-base protection plus style available from at least half of bases; alternate good styles allowed.
resistance: General every-base protection plus no retained supported efficient non-style route from any base.
selection: Generate legal route endpoints, qualify proposal style, then prioritize minimum pure-paint world separation before featured magnitude. Audit every base before acceptance. No failed style is relabeled as a success.
validation: Same fixed rules and palette set on both seeds. Second seed is fresh numerical replication, not player validation. Dense-check leading passing opportunities and strongest protected near-misses.
labels: Intended style stays visible in any subsequent lab.
scope: Offline feasibility only; no live holes, par, tolerance, palette definitions, or animations changed.
